image_query: Vittala Temple Hampi musical pillars Ranga Mantapa
tweets: The Vittala Temple at Hampi, built under Vijayanagara king Kṛṣṇadevarāya in the 16th century, holds a hall of granite pillars carved to sing. Struck lightly, each column rings with the note of a different instrument — vīṇā, mṛdaṅga, tablā — cut whole from a single block of stone.
